mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS side_effect_operations ( tenant_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, tool_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, downstream_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, params_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, params_json CLOB NOT NULL, operation_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, response_text CLOB, submit_count INT NOT NULL, lookup_count INT NOT NULL, next_lookup BIGINT NOT NULL, retry_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id, tool_name, operation_id))
UPDATE side_effect_operations SET operation_status='UNKNOWN' WHERE operation_status='RUNNING'
